findings.message: Figures/RTL: fig-U9-4.ur.svg and fig-U9-4.ur.dark.svg are geometrically broken. The RTL mirroring applied cx -> 780-cx to the arrow-hole circles without moving the target group translates, so 9 of 16 holes render outside the 780-wide viewBox. Browser-measured (render-inspection.json): the target at translate(390,110) has all four holes off-canvas, so the "قابلِ اعتماد، صحیح نہیں" (reliable, not valid) target renders EMPTY; the targets at (110,110), (670,110) and (250,330) show only 1-2 of their 4 holes, contradicting their labels (the "reliable and valid" target shows off-centre holes; "valid in aim, not reliable" shows one near-centre hole). The "دونوں سے خالی" label sits at x=530 while its target is at x=250, and the caption's last line clips past the left viewBox edge (x=-3.8). Repair: mirror each hole within its group (cx -> -cx) and mirror the group translate x (110<->670, 250->530), or mirror the absolute centres and re-derive holes; keep labels with their targets.

Figures/RTL: fig-U9-2.ur.svg and dark variant draw unmirrored vertical dividers. EN dividers 122/332/548 mirror to 658/448/232, but the UR grid is "M 658 14V426M332 14V426M548 14V426": 332 and 548 were left in place. The cell text is anchored for the correct mirrored grid, so the browser measures 6 divider strikes over header and cell text ("کب ہوتی ہے", "وہ فیصلہ جو وہ جاتی ہے", "کہاں سے شروع کریں؛ کیا", "دوبارہ سکھائیں، آگے بڑھیں،"). Same defect family as the Unit 7 G5 round-1 findings. Repair: redraw the grid as M658/M448/M232.

Figures/semantics: fig-U9-3.ur.svg and dark variant carry the untranslated G3 round-1 repair. The teacher-made trades cell still reads "موازنہ اور دفاع چھوڑ کر مناسبت لیتا ہے: اسی جماعت کے فیصلے" (trades comparability AND defensibility for fit), the PRE-repair English; commit b2ff0b3b restored the EN cell to "trades comparability for fit" and the Urdu prose agrees ("موازنے کی قیمت پر", topic-01.mdx:48). The Urdu figure teaches a different trade than the English figure and the Urdu prose. Additionally three trades-column cell texts clip past the left viewBox edge (x=-2.4, -50.9, -8.4 under fallback fonts; -11.5 with the Nastaliq webfont injected), cutting words off. Repair: drop دفاع, re-wrap the cell text within the column, and regenerate both variants.

Figures/terminology: fig-U9-5.ur.svg and dark variant render "evidence" as شہادت (testimony) throughout - "1. شہادت لیں", "ابھی کی تعلم کی شہادت لیں:", "شہادت کو مقصد کے مقابلے پڑھیں", "چکر تبھی تشکیلی ہے جب شہادت کوئی فیصلہ بدلے", "لی، سمجھی اور محفوظ کی گئی شہادت" - plus the title/desc. This is the known repo-wide defect family (شہادت vs ثبوت); the pre-flight lint commit 72c14f85 swept the MDX prose (correctly ثبوت) but not the SVG labels. The concept graph carries the same defect (concepts/unit-09.md CON:9-1 "تشخیص بطور فیصلے کے لیے شہادت" and CON:9-6 "شہادت، تشریح، عمل", both G5-flagged for review). Also in fig-U9-5.ur the arrowhead marker path was mapped into 780-space ("M 780 0L 770 5L 780 10z") inside the 10x10 marker viewport, so all three arrows (two solid, one dashed return) render headless and the cycle direction is unreadable. Repair: ثبوت in all figure labels and concept graph; restore the marker path to M0 0L10 5L0 10z (markers need no mirroring - orient=auto handles direction).

Figures/RTL: fig-U9-6.ur.svg and dark variant keep the EN divider position 436 instead of its mirror 344. The misplaced divider strikes the footer rule sentence "پہلے فیصلہ نام کریں، پھر فیصلہ وقت چنے۔" (bbox 281..499 crosses x=436) and the missing 344 boundary lets the formative and summative columns visually merge. Terminology bank departures on the unit's six core terms, with the unit contradicting itself three ways - conform-or-rule escalation to the owner (style guide ## Terminology bank; same posture as the Unit 7 G5 round-1 blocking finding). Prose uses جانچ (Assessment; bank تشخیص row 19), تشکیلی جانچ / مجموعی جانچ (Formative / Summative; bank تشکیلی تشخیص row 20, مجموعی جائزہ/جامع تشخیص row 21), درستگی 30x (Validity; bank صداقت row 79), اعتبار 26x (Reliability; bank اعتماديت row 80) and معیاری ٹیسٹ (Standardised Test; bank معیاری آزمائش row 75). Meanwhile topic-03's headings use تشکیلی/مجموعی تشخیص, the index key_terms block declares تشکیلی جائزہ (not in the bank; check:pipeline-gate FR-016c will fail the moment translation_status flips to reviewed), and the figures plus concept graph use the banked forms while the prose never does. Unit 10 already cross-references "یونٹ 9 کی درستگی" (unit-10/topic-02.mdx:38,71), so an owner ruling must cover both units: either bank the prose forms (and fix the bank's own اعتماديت Arabic-yeh U+064A codepoint defect) or re-translate U9+U10 to the bank. The translator's جانچ/تشخیص split for assessment/evaluation also inverts the bank's Assessment->تشخیص mapping inside this unit's title.

Semantics/negation: topic-02.mdx:54 (misconception box) and :77 (summary) render "and neither is answered by the pass rate" / "and neither is answered by difficulty" as "اور نہیں کا جواب پاس فیصد سے ملتا ہے" / "اور نہیں کا جواب مشکل سے ملتا ہے". As written this most naturally reads "and the answer 'no' comes from the pass rate / from difficulty" - the opposite assertion, and exactly the misconception the paragraph is clearing; even the charitable parse ("neither's answer comes from...") is ungrammatical Urdu. The unit summary renders the same construction correctly ("مشکل کسی کیفیت سوال کا جواب نہیں دیتی", unit-assessment.mdx:26), so this is a translation defect. Repair: e.g. "اور پاس فیصد ان میں سے کسی سوال کا جواب نہیں دیتی" and "اور مشکل ان میں سے کسی کا جواب نہیں دیتی".

Semantics/wrong referent: "corridor" is translated گلی (street) in the student-facing prose - topic-03.mdx:26 "اسی گلی کے دو استاد" ("two teachers of the same street") for "Two teachers in the same corridor", ERQ-3 title "دو گلیاں" (unit-assessment.mdx:113, 171) and teacher-notes rows 40/52/68 - while the concept graph uses راہداری (concepts/unit-09.md:21). A school corridor is برآمدہ/گلیار/راہداری, not a street; the scenario's setting is misdescribed and the noun has three different Urdu renderings across artifacts. Repair: unify on راہداری (or برآمدہ) in topic-03, ERQ-3 and the teacher notes.

G3 dependency not satisfied for the bound English inputs (owner escalation per the GQUR-300 PR #65 precedent). The only G3 evidence is advisory run001 (disposition revise, 4 blocking findings) reviewed against the PRE-repair English at 631bb07d; 11 of its 98 bound inputs genuinely changed in the G3 repair commit b2ff0b3b (EN index.mdx, topic-01.mdx, unit-assessment.mdx, concepts/unit-09.md, figures/unit-09.md, sources/texts/seifert2009.md, sources/unit-09.md, fig-U9-3/fig-U9-4 light+dark SVGs - g3-dependency-drift.log), no round-2 G3 review of the repaired English exists, and the report is unsigned under ADR-0019 advisory mode. The contract's accepted-signed-G3-for-current-inputs requirement therefore cannot be met; this review nevertheless performed the full comparison against the current bound English. The owner must either commission a fresh G3 round on the repaired English or record an explicit dependency ruling.

Register: systematic literal calque کھلانا for "feed a decision" (39 occurrences: "وہ فیصلہ جو وہ کھلاتا ہے", "فیصلے کو کھلایا", "کل کی تدریس کھلاتے ہوئے"...). The metaphor is consistent and decodable but not idiomatic Urdu for supplying evidence to a decision; consider "جس فیصلے کے لیے ثبوت دیتا ہے" / "جس فیصلے کو آگے بڑھاتا ہے" or an explicit owner-approved coinage.
